# corpus-bad-stale-summary - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the operator deciding whether persistence changed.
**Outcome:** a stale machine summary that says no persistence while a todo adds it.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；3 个实施 todo；不涉及持久化与重启恢复。

## Scope
### Affected user and ideal state
| Row | Statement | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 重启后评审记录仍可读取。 | 4 交付。 |
| GAP-1 | 重启后记录丢失。 | 4 关闭。 |

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1
- Wave 2: task 4

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

- [ ] 1. 增加记录形状校验
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 在 `lib/review-lint.js:1-3` 旁增加记录形状校验函数；不改变既有输出。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: 4
  References: `lib/review-lint.js:1-3`；`docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: `node --test test/review-lint.test.mjs` 退出 0。
  QA scenarios: Happy “shape-validated” 记录形状被校验。Failure “shape-missed” 形状不合法时未拒绝。
  Commit: Y | feat(review): validate record shape

- [ ] 2. 增加配置读取
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 读取 `docs/fidelity.md` 中的默认配置说明；不引入新依赖。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: 4
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-2.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 配置读取路径有文档依据。
  QA scenarios: Happy “config-read” 配置被读取。Failure “config-missing” 缺配置时启动失败。
  Commit: Y | feat(config): read defaults

- [ ] 3. 增加错误映射
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 把校验错误映射为诊断码；不修改持久化层。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: 4
  References: `docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-3.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 诊断码与文档一致。
  QA scenarios: Happy “codes-mapped” 错误码可读。Failure “codes-raw” 原始异常泄漏。
  Commit: Y | feat(review): map diagnostics

- [ ] 4. 新增重启后的持久化读取
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 新建 `lib/review-store.js` 并在重启后从磁盘读取记录；不修改既有解析器。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 2 | Blocked by: 1 | Blocks: F1
  References: `lib/review-lint.js:1-3`；`lib/review-store.js`；`$E/task-4.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 重启后读取返回同一记录。
  QA scenarios: Happy “restart-reads” 重启后记录仍可读取。Failure “restart-lost” 重启后记录丢失。
  Commit: Y | feat(store): persist review records

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit

  Closes: GAP-1

  QA scenarios: Happy “audit-passes” 逐项对照证据。Failure “no-evidence” 缺证据即拒绝。
  Commit: N | 审计不单独提交
